mistakes.text: The treaty is said to take three years to write.
mistakes.normalized: the treaty is said to take three years to write
mistakes.feedback_sk: Písanie bolo v minulosti, preto perfect Infinitive: „is said to have taken“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Psaní bylo v minulosti, proto perfect Infinitive: „is said to have taken“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The writing happened in the past, so use the perfect Infinitive: “is said to have taken”.

mistakes.text: The treaty is said that it took three years to write.
mistakes.normalized: the treaty is said that it took three years to write
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po podmete s „is said“ nasleduje Infinitive, nie „that“: „is said to have taken“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po podmětu s „is said“ následuje Infinitive, ne „that“: „is said to have taken“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When the subject comes first, “is said” takes an Infinitive, not “that”: “is said to have taken”.

mistakes.text: People say the treaty took three years to write.
mistakes.normalized: people say the treaty took three years to write
mistakes.feedback_sk: Precvičuje sa Passive: „The treaty is said to have taken…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Procvičuje se Passive: „The treaty is said to have taken…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises the Passive: “The treaty is said to have taken…”.

mistakes.text: The treaty is said to have took three years to write.
mistakes.normalized: the treaty is said to have took three years to write
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „to have“ patrí past participle: „taken“, nie „took“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „to have“ patří past participle: „taken“, ne „took“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “to have” use the past participle: “taken”, not “took”.

mistakes.text: The treaty is said to have taken three years for writing.
mistakes.normalized: the treaty is said to have taken three years for writing
mistakes.kind: for writing instead of to write
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „take + čas“ patrí Infinitive: „took three years to write“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „take + čas“ patří Infinitive: „took three years to write“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “take + time” use the Infinitive: “three years to write”.
